panels.description: Director Cassian Lock approaches Alex and Ada at the registry, examining the record before looking at Alex. Leave upper display space.
Lock places a formal assignment document on the registry table. Leave upper document space.
The offer shows debt clearance, employment and House administration of Adrian's estate. Leave upper document space.
Alex closes the registry while Lock taps the screen and freezes immediate rights. Leave upper display space.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Assign the estate to House administration. Your debt clears. Halyard access becomes permanent.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Refuse, and immediate commercial rights freeze pending review.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: You’re asking me to sell work I didn’t make.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Then find the people who made it.
